In this community you get to follow one of the best traders in the world, Brando, live. A trader who has verified turning $6K into 8 figures. He gives a live alert for every trade, so you can literally watch how he thinks and trades in real time. But don’t get me wrong: even if Brando were literally whispering in your ear what to do, it takes an enormous amount of mental discipline to actually do what he does. He has a phenomenal appetite for risk and sees things that I - and probably most people - simply don’t see. And that’s exactly what allows him to make some absolutely massive trades, with a win rate of well over 70% based on my own meticulous tracking of his trades in an spreadsheet.
Eventually you realize that you have to develop your own trading style, because you’re not Brando. And that may be one of the most important lessons of all. He encourages everyone to think independently and develop their own style. He teaches you not only the universal principles of trading, but in many ways also the universal principles of living a good life.

I also don’t want to leave out his right-hand man, trader Shoof. He’s often remarkably in sync with Brando, while at the same time bringing his own perspective and a wide range of trading ideas to the table. A lot of members have had great success with his ideas. Perhaps most importantly of all: the community itself. I’ve been around for quite a while, but Elite Options is one of the best things I’ve come across along the way. It’s an incredible mix of experienced, highly successful traders, intermediate traders, and beginners, all encouraging, helping, and learning from one another. The group dynamic is something special: tons of knowledge, a genuine willingness to help each other, and above all, a lot of humor. And as a European, I personally also draw a lot of energy from the contagious, American optimism within this group. Honestly, at this point, I’m not sure what I would do without this community.
Lost every dollar I have 👍

I've been searching for a trading group like Elite Option Group for a long time. After discovering Brando's YouTube videos, I spent several weeks following his trades before deciding to join. It quickly became clear that this group is different from most trading communities.  What sets Brando and the Shoof Trading community apart is their focus on more than just technical analysis. While they teach momentum trading, key levels, market sentiment, and overall market structure, they place equal emphasis on the psychology of trading—patience, discipline, risk management, and strategic decision-making.

Unlike many groups that focus on alerts and signals, Elite Option Group teaches you how to think independently and manage trades on your own. The goal is to help you become a self-sufficient trader, not someone who depends on others for every decision.

The group's atmosphere is exceptional. Members openly share ideas and experiences, creating a supportive environment that feels more like a family than a typical trading chat room.
One of the most valuable lessons I've learned is that trading reveals who you truly are under pressure. When a trade moves against you and your own money is on the line, how do you react? Do you panic, hesitate, or stay disciplined? This group helps you recognize those behaviors, accept your weaknesses, and continuously improve. Trading becomes a journey of self-discovery, emotional control, and personal growth.
Most importantly, Elite Option Group helps you develop a trading system and style that fit your own personality and strengths rather than simply copying someone else's approach. You learn to trust your process, understand market sentiment, adapt to changing conditions, and build lasting confidence in your decisions.

If your goal is long-term success, trading independence, and personal growth, I highly recommend Brando and the Shoof Trading community.

I've been a member of Elite Options Pro 2 for about a month now, and while there's some solid educational content and a few helpful trade alerts from Brando that have guided my entries on basic setups, it's not quite living up to the hype for me. The Discord community is active, which is nice for bouncing ideas, and the chartbooks are straightforward for visualizing trades. However, the signals feel hit-or-miss—I've followed a handful that worked out okay for small gains, but several others led to quick losses because the risk management tips weren't detailed enough for volatile days. Shoof's contributions are there, but they often seem rushed compared to Brando's. For the price, I expected more live sessions or personalized feedback, but it's mostly self-paced, which isn't ideal if you're intermediate and want deeper dives. It's a good intro for options newbies, but if you're looking for reliable, high-win-rate pro-level stuff, you might need to supplement with other resources. Worth a trial if you're curious, but I'm on the fence about renewing.
